facts.text: The Wisconsin Tuition Promise covers tuition and segregated fees not covered by federal and state grants for resident students with household adjusted gross income of $55,000 or less.

sources.title: UW-Whitewater Wisconsin Tuition Promise
sources.quote: The program guarantees the coverage of tuition and segregated fees not already covered by federal and state grants for students at the Whitewater and Rock County campuses who meet the eligibility requirements.

sources.title: UW-Whitewater Wisconsin Tuition Promise
sources.quote: Household adjusted gross income $55,000 or less, as reflected in the student's Free Application for Federal Student Aid, or FAFSA
